blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World simulation is inherently multisensory, demanding synchronized visual and acoustic dynamics in real time. Yet prevailing interactive world models remain strictly silent, focusing exclusively on visual rendering and control while overlooking the acoustic dimension. We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction. We curate a high-fidelity spatial audio-visual dataset with true stereo acoustics and metric camera poses, upon which we pre-train a bidirectional teacher conditioned on 6-DoF camera trajectories and user actions. To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU. Furthermore, we formalize spatial-acoustic consistency and introduce HelixBench to evaluate whether synthesized sound fields faithfully track dynamic viewpoint motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.
blocks.zh: 世界模拟本质上是多感性的,要求实时同步的视觉和声学动态. 然而,目前流行的交互式世界模式仍然严格保持沉默,只注重视觉渲染和控制,而忽略声学层面。 我们介绍HelixWorld,一种实时交互式视听世界模型,视觉场景和照相机定位空间立体声在用户互动下在本土共同演化. 我们用真实的立体声学和公制相机来管理一个高真实度的空间视听数据集,我们以此为条件预先训练一个以6-DoF相机轨迹和用户动作为条件的双向教师。 为了实现低纬度因果互动,我们通过在线轨迹蒸馏损失将老师分解成几步流体的学生,在单一的GPU上维持24个FPS的无漂流联合视听推出. 此外,我们正式确定空间-声学一致性,并引入Helix Bench来评价综合音域是否忠实地跟踪动态视角运动。 广泛的实验表明,HelixWorld在视觉忠心度和应答度方面与最先进的无声世界模型相匹配,同时在相机对齐的空间声波浸润度方面大大超过了现有的基线.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Interactive world models [ 12 , 1 , 40 , 7 , 3 , 53 , 23 , 37 ] provide an effective paradigm for physical simulation and virtual environments, allowing users to control generated rollouts in real time via keyboard actions or camera trajectories.
Beyond visual synthesis, physical interactions naturally produce sound that conveys critical cues about surface materials, contact forces, and off-screen events.
To provide immersive simulation, an interactive world model should synthesize visual scenes and spatially grounded stereo audio responsive to user inputs.
However, prevailing world models focus almost exclusively on visual streams, leaving the acoustic dimension largely unexplored.
Despite recent efforts to incorporate audio into world models [ 52 ] , achieving fine-grained spatial-acoustic alignment under dynamic camera movement remains an open challenge due to the absence of high-quality spatial audio paired with camera trajectories, severe error accumulation during long-horizon streaming, and instability of causal model training.
blocks.zh:
交互式世界模型[12, 1, 40, 7, 3, 53, 23, 37]为物理模拟和虚拟环境提供了一个有效的范例,允许用户通过键盘动作或相机轨迹实时控制生成的展开.
除了视觉合成之外,物理相互作用自然产生声音,传达关于表面材料,接触力,以及外屏事件的关键提示.
为了提供浸润模拟,互动世界模型应合成视觉场景和空间定位的立体声响应用户输入.
然而,目前流行的世界模型几乎完全侧重于视觉流,使得声学维度基本上没有得到探讨.
尽管最近努力将音频纳入世界模型[52],但是在动态相机运动下实现精细的空间声学对接仍然是一项公开的挑战,原因是没有高质量的空间声学与相机轨迹对接,在长距离流线期间出现严重误差,以及因果模型培训不稳定。

blocks.en:
Natively coupling interactive visual scenes with spatial audio introduces fundamental challenges that straightforward adaptations of existing models fail to resolve.
Cascaded video-to-audio models [ 6 , 39 ] lack access to camera trajectories and user actions, leaving sound oblivious to ego-motion, while their sequential latency precludes real-time responsiveness.
Meanwhile, bidirectional audio-visual foundation models [ 13 , 11 ] lack external control interfaces. Moreover, naively converting them into causal autoregressive rollouts leads to catastrophic multimodal drift, where historical error accumulation rapidly degrades both visual stability and acoustic fidelity over extended sequences.
blocks.zh:
将互动的视觉场景与空间音频进行本土结合,带来了一些根本挑战,而对现有模型的直截了当的修改却无法解决。
cascaded video-to-audio model [6,39] 缺乏摄像头的轨迹和用户动作,使声音忽略了自我运动,而其相继的延时性则排除了实时响应.
同时,双向视听基础模型[13,11]缺乏外部控制接口. 此外,天真地将它们转化为因果的自动递减式推出会导致灾难性的多式联运漂移,因为历史上的错误积累使视觉稳定性和声学忠诚度迅速降低于扩展序列。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we present HelixWorld , a real-time interactive audio-visual world model with camera-aligned spatial sound, trained in two stages (see Sec. 3 for details).
First, bidirectional teacher training establishes action controllability and spatial-acoustic fidelity.
We inject continuous 6-DoF camera trajectories into visual attention via PRoPE [ 24 ] and discrete user actions into diffusion timesteps via AdaLN-Zero [ 32 ] . Cross-modal attention subsequently binds visual geometry with acoustic features, naturally transferring camera ego-motion into realistic stereo panning.
Second, causal distillation converts this bidirectional teacher into a few-step causal student.
To mitigate compounding drift under self-forcing [ 18 ] , we introduce an online trajectory distillation loss that supervises student velocities with teacher Probability Flow ODE targets directly from intermediate rollout states.
Combined with long-horizon streaming fine-tuning, HelixWorld substantially reduces exposure bias and sustains synchronized audio-visual generation at 24 24 FPS on a single NVIDIA H800 GPU.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们介绍了HelixWorld ,这是一个实时交互式视听世界模型,与相机相配合的空间声音,分两个阶段培训(详情见第3章)。
首先,双向师资培训确立了动作可控性和空间声学忠诚性。
我们通过PROPE将连续6-DoF相机轨迹注入视觉注意力[24],通过AdaLN-Zero将离散的用户动作注入扩散时间步[32]. 跨模式的注意后来将视觉几何与声学特征结合,自然将相机的自我运动转移到现实的立体声平整中.
第二,因果衍射将这个双向老师转化为几个步骤的因果学生.
为了减轻自我强制下复合漂移[18],我们引入了在线轨迹蒸馏损失,通过教师概率流动ODE目标直接从中间推出状态监督学生的速度.
与长距流线微调相结合,HelixWorld大幅降低曝光偏差,并在单NVIDIA H800 GPU上保持24 24 FPS同步的视听生成.

blocks.en:
Beyond model architecture, the successful training of such an interactive system requires large-scale data coupling visual dynamics with high-quality spatial acoustics.
However, existing world model datasets are largely silent; even when audio is present in existing video corpora, it is heavily contaminated by post-production background music, voiceover narration, or pseudo-stereo tracks that provide no authentic spatial cues.
To bridge this training data gap, we construct a scalable, coarse-to-fine curation pipeline structured by computational cost (Sec. 2 ).
The pipeline deploys inter-channel energy probes to eliminate pseudo-stereo audio at ingestion, utilizes multimodal LLMs to purge non-world footage and non-diegetic audio, and automatically recovers frame-accurate metric camera poses paired with decoupled three-track captions (visual scene, foreground acoustic events, and background ambiance), establishing a high-fidelity spatial audio-visual training corpus.
blocks.zh:
除了模型架构外,成功培训这样一个交互式系统需要大规模的数据耦合视觉动态与高质量的空间声学.
然而,现有的世界模型数据集大多是无声的;即使音频存在于现有的视频corpora中,它也受到制作后背景音乐,语音翻唱,或没有提供真实空间提示的伪定形音轨的严重污染.
为了弥补这一培训数据差距,我们建造了一个按计算成本结构的可伸缩、粗糙至精细的加工管道(第2款)。
该管道部署跨通道的能量探测器,以消除摄入时的伪定型音频,利用多式联运LLMs清除非世界镜头和非狄氏音频,并自动恢复帧精确度的度量摄像头外观与脱钩的三轨字幕(视觉场景,前缘音响事件和背景氛围)配对,建立高真实度空间视听培训机构.

blocks.en:
Finally, evaluating an interactive audio-visual world model requires assessing whether synthesized audio physically aligns with dynamic camera motion.
Existing world model benchmarks [ 51 ] focus exclusively on visual dynamics while neglecting the acoustic stream, whereas conventional audio-visual benchmarks [ 4 ] evaluate only short, static clips without camera movement.
To close this gap, we introduce HelixBench , the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating interactive audio-visual world models (Sec. 4 ).
Spanning 1,015 1{,}015 human-verified cases across diverse environments and interaction modes, HelixBench evaluates models across five key dimensions: temporal synchronization, audio-visual semantics, text-audio alignment, acoustic dynamics, and spatial-acoustic consistency .
In particular, it formalizes spatial-acoustic consistency by correlating on-screen sound emitter positions with stereo audio panning, directly quantifying whether the synthesized sound field physically rotates with camera ego-motion.
blocks.zh:
最后,评价交互式视听世界模型需要评估合成音频是否与动态相机运动进行物理配合。
现有的世界模型基准[51]只注重视觉动态,而忽略了声学流,而传统的视听基准[4]只评价短片,静态片段,没有摄像移动.
为了缩小这一差距,我们引入了Helix Bench,这是第一个专门用于评价交互式视听世界模型的基准(第4节)。
Helix Bench在5个关键方面评价模型:时间同步、视听语义、文本-音频对齐、声学动态和空间-音响一致性。
特别是,它通过将屏幕上的声音发射器位置与立体声压相连接,将空间-音响一致性正式化,直接量化合成的声音场是否与相机自负-运动进行物理旋转.

blocks.en: 2 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 2 数据集建设

blocks.en:
Training interactive audio-visual world models requires continuous dynamics, authentic stereo acoustics, and synchronized control.
Yet existing datasets largely lack authentic spatial audio, while in-the-wild video suffers from shot cuts, overlays, and non-diegetic sound.
We address this with an automated pipeline (Fig. 2 ) that filters multimodal artifacts while annotating metric camera poses, discrete actions, and decoupled captions to power bidirectional pre-training and causal streaming distillation.
More details are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
培训交互式视听世界模型需要持续动态,真实的立体声学,同步控制.
然而,现有的数据集基本上缺乏真实的空间音频,而内部的视频则受到镜头剪切、覆盖和非语音的影响。
我们用一个自动管道(图2)来解决这个问题,该管道过滤多式工艺品,同时标注测量相机的外观、离散动作和脱钩的字幕,以产生双向的前培训和因果流衍射。
详见附录C。

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Sources
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 数据来源

blocks.en: We assemble footage across three complementary sources (Table 2.1 ). Real-world video captures first-person exploration across diverse indoor and outdoor environments. Game footage records first- and third-person gameplay with native audio, logging ground-truth camera trajectories and control telemetry. Open-source corpora incorporate audio-equipped video subsets [ 25 , 3 ] , subjected to identical stereo and semantic curation.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了三个补充来源的录像(表2.1)。 真实世界视频捕捉跨不同室内外环境的第一人称探索. 游戏镜头记录第一人称和第三人称游戏游戏,配有原声,记录地面真实相机轨迹和控制遥测. 开源公司(Open-source corpora)包含有音频设备的视频子集[25,3],受到相同的立体和语义化处理.

blocks.en: 2.2 Curation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.2 管道

blocks.en:
Raw footage cannot be fed directly into training due to noise and artifacts across audio-visual streams.
We design a four-stage pipeline (Fig. 2 ) ordered by cost, pruning corrupted data before invoking heavy models.
blocks.zh:
由于声音和跨视听流的文物,无法将原始录像直接输入培训。
我们设计了四阶段的管道(图2) 由成本订购,在使用重力模型之前 搜索损坏的数据。

blocks.en:
Raw videos are split into continuous shots via scene transition detection [ 2 ] , discarding fragments under five seconds.
Acoustically, lightweight probes use inter-channel correlation and energy differences to remove mono downmixes and duplicated channels.
Visually, optical character recognition (OCR) [ 54 ] and heuristic detectors prune overlays, banners, and watermarks.
Perceptual quality scoring [ 20 ] and motion screening remove severely degraded or frozen clips while preserving static views with physical motion.
blocks.zh:
原始视频通过场景过渡探测分为连续镜头[2],在5秒内丢弃碎片.
从声学上讲,轻量级探测器使用跨通道的关联性和能量差异来去除单向下混合和重复的通道.
视觉上,光学字符识别(OCR)[54]和热力探测器prune覆盖,横幅,以及水印.
知觉质量评分[20]和运动筛选除去严重退化或冻结的片段,同时保留静态视线与物理运动.

blocks.en:
Continuous shots are partitioned into fixed-length clips matching the backbone training window.
Video and audio are sliced synchronously without crossing shot boundaries, ensuring temporal alignment.
blocks.zh:
连续射击被分割成与骨干训练窗口相匹配的固定长度剪辑.
视频和音频是同步切开的,不跨越镜头边界,确保时间一致。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Data pipeline. Raw video and audio pass four cost-ordered stages; surviving clips fork into parallel camera recovery and decoupled captioning branches to yield the trainable corpus.
blocks.zh: 图2:数据管道。 原始的视频和音频通过四个按成本排序的阶段;幸存的片段叉入平行的相机恢复和脱钩的字幕分支,以产生可培训的单元。

blocks.en:
To resolve defects requiring high-level scene understanding, an audio-visual multimodal large language model (MLLM) [ 33 ] evaluates clips under a structured perception schema.
Visually, it purges non-embodied content (e.g., picture-in-picture, talking heads, occluding overlays) and resolves text ambiguous to OCR.
Acoustically, it strips non-diegetic post-production tracks (background music, voiceover, synthetic effects).
Crucially, sounds are judged by causal origin rather than visibility, preserving off-screen acoustics and natural speech.
blocks.zh:
为了解决需要高水平场景理解的缺陷,一个视听多式大型语言模型(MLLM)[33]在结构化感知计划下评价片段.
从视觉上看,它清除了不健全的内容(例如图片内映,说话头,吞噬覆盖),解决文本对OCR的模棱两可.
声学上,它会剥离非笛音的制作后音轨(背景音乐,语音翻唱,合成效果).
关键是,声音是根据因果关系而不是能见度来判断的,保留了外屏声学和自然语音.

blocks.en:
Accepted clips enter two parallel annotation branches.
For web and real-world footage, the camera branch estimates per-frame poses via VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 42 ] and recovers metric scale with Depth Anything V3 [ 26 ] , falling back to Metric3D v2 [ 16 ] when necessary; game footage uses engine-logged ground truth.
After discarding tracking failures and physically implausible trajectories, surviving motions are discretized into an 81-class action vocabulary (Sec. 3.1 ; benchmarks in Appendix C ).
Concurrently, the captioning branch synthesizes three decoupled text tracks via independent forward passes: video-only, audio-only, and joint audio-visual descriptions that bind visible sound emitters to their acoustics.
A clip is retained only when both branches succeed.
blocks.zh:
接受的剪辑输入两个平行的注释分支.
对于网络和现实世界的镜头,相机分支估计每帧通过VGGT-ship complete\Omega [42] 并用深度 Anything V3 [26] 恢复度量尺度,必要时回落到Metric3D v2 [16] ;游戏镜头使用引擎记录的地面真实性.
在丢弃跟踪故障和物理上不合理的轨迹后,幸存的运动被碟片化为81级动作词汇(Sec. 3.1;附录C中的基准).
同时,标题分支通过独立的前传通道合成了三条脱钩的文字音轨:只录影带,只录音带,以及联合视听描述,将可见的音效发射器与它们的音响连接在一起.
只有两个分支都成功时才保留一个剪辑.

blocks.en:
In total, this multi-stage pipeline systematically purges visual artifacts and acoustic contamination across the 4.1k raw hours.
Through successive screening and pose verification, 3.0k hours (amounting to 2.1M synchronized clips) survive to form the final trainable corpus, achieving an overall yield of 73.1% (Table 2.2 ).
The resulting corpus provides a camera-conditioned audio-visual foundation with authentic stereo sound fields and per-frame action annotations, directly powering bidirectional pre-training and causal streaming distillation (Sec. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
总的来说,这种多阶段管道在4.1k的生时段系统清洗视觉文物和声波污染。
通过连续的筛选和进行核查,3.0k小时(高达2.1M同步剪辑)得以存活,形成最后的可训练装置,总产量达到73.1%(表2.2)。
由此产生的程序提供了具有真实立体声场和每帧动作说明的照相机条件的视听基础,直接为双向前培训和因果流衍射提供动力(第3节)。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
An interactive audio-visual world model requires responsive action following (steering visual dynamics and spatial sound) and causal interactivity (real-time generation).
To this end, HelixWorld follows a two-stage training pipeline (Figs. 3 and 4 ): Sec. 3.1 trains a bidirectional teacher with progressive camera and action conditioning, while Sec. 3.2 distills it into a few-step causal student.
blocks.zh:
交互式视听世界模型要求后续反应行动(探究视觉动态和空间声音)和因果互动(实时生成).
为此,HelixWorld遵循两阶段培训管道(图3和图4): 第3.1节用进步相机和动作调节训练双向教师,而第3.2节则将其蒸馏成几步因果学生.

blocks.en: 3.1 Bidirectional Teacher Training
blocks.zh: 3.1 双向教师培训

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Progressive condition injection. Three-stage training: optimize control modules with the backbone frozen, unfreeze the video branch, and jointly train the full audio-visual backbone.
blocks.zh: 图3:递进状态注射。 三阶段培训:与骨干冷冻优化控制模块,解冻视频分支,联合培养完整的视听骨干.

blocks.en:
We train the bidirectional model on our corpus (Sec. 2 ) by progressively injecting control signals.
We employ both continuous camera trajectories and discrete user actions as control inputs.
Both controls enter the video branch and propagate to the audio branch through cross-modal attention.
blocks.zh:
我们通过逐步注入控制信号来训练我们身体上的双向模型(第2节)。
我们既采用连续相机轨迹,又采用离散用户动作作为控制输入.

To enable real-time generation, we distill the bidirectional teacher into a few-step causal student.
Addressing the visual drift of standard self-forcing (DMD2) [ 18 , 48 ] , we propose an online trajectory distillation loss that anchors student rollouts to the teacher’s probability flow, complemented by long-horizon streaming tuning.

解决标准自强制(DMD2)的视觉漂移问题[18,48],我们提出在线轨迹蒸馏损失方案,将学生的推移推向教师的概率流,辅之以长视流调。

blocks.en:
We first synchronize video latents and co-temporal audio tokens into temporal blocks of length Δ ​ t \Delta t .
Attention within each block is fully bidirectional to maintain audio-visual interactions, while cross-block attention is strictly causal via a sliding Key-Value (KV) cache.
Based on this structure, we adapt the teacher using the joint flow-matching objective ℒ FM {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{FM}} (Eq. 2 ) conditioned on ground-truth history firstly.
To provide a stable starting checkpoint for few-step sampling, we then initialize the student by regressing its single-step predictions onto the Probability Flow ODE endpoints of the causal teacher [ 56 ] : ℒ init ​ ( θ ) = 𝔼 𝒙 σ , σ , 𝒄 ​ ‖ 𝒙 ^ 0 θ ​ ( 𝒙 σ , σ , 𝒄 ) − 𝒙 ^ 0 teacher ​ ( 𝒙 σ , 𝒄 ) ‖ 2 2 , {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{init}}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_{\sigma},\sigma,{\bm{c}}}\left\|\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0}^{\theta}({\bm{x}}_{\sigma},\sigma,{\bm{c}})-\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0}^{\mathrm{teacher}}({\bm{x}}_{\sigma},{\bm{c}})\right\|_{2}^{2}, (3) where 𝒙 σ {\bm{x}}_{\sigma} is the joint audio-visual latent, and 𝒄 {\bm{c}} denotes historical context and conditions.

Standard self-forcing uses distribution matching ( ℒ DMD {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{DMD}} ) [ 48 ] , updating the student via score differences between a frozen teacher and a learned fake-score model tracking rollout distributions.
However, distribution matching alone reduces sample diversity [ 44 ] and causes long-rollout drift (Fig. 8 ; Table 8 ).
To preserve diversity and stabilize rollouts, we introduce an online trajectory distillation loss ( ℒ traj {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{traj}} ) alongside ℒ DMD {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{DMD}} .

blocks.en: 4 HelixBench: A Benchmark for Audio-Visual World Models
blocks.zh: 4 Helix Bench:视听世界模式基准

blocks.en:
Existing world-model benchmarks evaluate only silent video generation [ 51 , 37 ] , while audio-visual benchmarks are restricted to static, non-interactive clips [ 4 ] .
In an interactive world model, the generated audio must sound realistic, synchronize with visual content, match text prompts, and adjust its stereo balance as the camera moves.
To evaluate these properties during interactive rollouts, we introduce HelixBench.
blocks.zh:
现有的世界模型基准只评价无声视频生成[51,37],而视听基准仅限于静态,非互动的片段[4].
在交互式世界模型中,生成的音频必须听起来现实,与视觉内容同步,匹配文本提示,并随着镜头的移动调整其立体平衡.
为了在互动推出时评价这些属性,我们介绍Helix Bench.

blocks.en:
HelixBench comprises 1,015 1{,}015 human-verified test clips across six scene domains and four subsets: Navigation, Perspective, Event, and Subject.
Each case provides a stereo reference clip, an initial frame, an audio-visual prompt, and continuous camera poses.
Audio quality is measured by KL divergence [ 22 ] and Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD) [ 21 ] on VGGish embeddings [ 15 ] , while multimodal alignment is evaluated via ImageBind [ 10 ] and CLAP [ 45 ] .
The Event subset measures temporal synchronization via DeSync [ 19 ] , while Perspective evaluates whether stereo audio pans with on-screen sources (Spatial, Appendix D ).
blocks.zh:
Helix Bench包含1,015 1{,}015个经过人验证的测试片段,跨越6个场景域和4个子集:导航,视角,事件,和主题.
每个案例都提供立体参考片段,初始帧,视听提示,连续镜头摆放.
音频质量由VGGish嵌入的KL差[22]和Fréchet音频距离(FAD)[21]测量,而多式联运配对则通过ImageBind[10]和CLAP[45]来评价.
Event 子集通过 DeSync [19] 测量时间同步,而Perspect 评价是否有带屏幕源的立体声盘(Spatial,附录D ).

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: HelixWorld builds on open-source LTX-2.3 and follows the two-stage training procedure in Sec. 3 . The full implementation details are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: HelixWorld以开源LTX-2.3为基础,并遵循第3节的两阶段培训程序. 详细执行情况见附录B。

blocks.en:
To evaluate visual quality, audio fidelity, and audio-visual alignment, we compare HelixWorld against strong baselines [ 50 , 52 , 5 , 9 , 37 , 35 , 55 , 8 , 43 ] .
Because EchoWM is the only world model supporting audio-visual generation, we also construct cascaded dubbing baselines using video-to-audio (V2A) models [ 28 , 29 , 39 ] .
Specifically, we mute HelixWorld outputs and re-dub them with these models, keeping visual content fixed to isolate audio performance (details in Appendix D ).
blocks.zh:
为了评价视觉质量、音频忠诚度和视听一致性,我们将HelixWorld比作强基线[50、52、5、9、37、35、55、8、43]。
由于EchoWM是唯一支持视听生成的世界模型,我们还使用视频对音频(V2A)模型构建了级联的双动基线[28,29,39].
具体来说,我们取消了HelixWorld的输出,并用这些模型重新粘贴它们,保持视觉内容固定以隔离音频性能(详见附录D).

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
For video quality, we benchmark on the WBench navigation split [ 51 ] (Table 3 ).
HelixWorld outperforms most open-source silent baselines across visual quality and control responsiveness, demonstrating faithful action following and physical plausibility.
To assess audio quality and multimodal coherence, we evaluate on HelixBench (Sec. 4 ) across audio fidelity, temporal sync, semantic alignment, and spatial consistency (Table 4 ; Appendix D ).
HelixWorld surpasses both EchoWM and cascaded dubbing pipelines.
While video-to-audio models achieve reasonable text alignment, they fail to capture emitter locations, resulting in negative spatial scores.
EchoWM retains coarse spatial cues but trails in acoustic quality and semantic binding.
These results demonstrate that HelixWorld effectively grounds spatial acoustics in interactive visual dynamics, achieving physically coherent audio-visual generation.
blocks.zh:
关于视频质量,我们以W Bench导航分解为基准[51](表3)。
HelixWorld在视觉质量和控制反应能力上超越了大多数开源的静态基线,表现出跟随和物理上的可信行动.
为了评估音频质量和多模式一致性,我们通过Helix Bench(第4节)评估音频忠贞性、时间同步、语义一致和空间一致性(表4;附录D)。
HelixWorld 超越了EchoWM和级联的欺骗管道。
虽然视频对音频模型实现了合理的文本对齐,但未能捕捉发射方位,导致负空间分数.
EchoWM保留粗细的空间提示,但在声学质量和语义绑定上留下痕迹.
这些结果表明,HelixWorld有效地将空间声学置于交互式视觉动态中,实现了物理上一致的视听生成.

blocks.en:
On a single NVIDIA H800 GPU, HelixWorld achieves a steady-state RTF of 0.77 at 768 × 512 768{\times}512 and 24 fps, including video and audio decoding.
This enables real-time responses to user control (details in Appendix D.7 ).
blocks.zh:
在单NVIDIA H800 GPU上,HelixWorld在768×512 768\times}512和24 fps上实现了0.77的稳态RTF,包括视频和音频解码.
这有助于对用户控制作出实时反应(详见附录D.7)。

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
To test whether staged conditioning prevents representation collapse (Sec. 3.1 ), we compare progressive against full fine-tuning.
Evaluating ViPE-recovered trajectories [ 17 ] , progressive fine-tuning reduces both rotation and translation errors (Table 6 ).
This confirms that gradually unfreezing branches is essential for learning geometric control while preserving pretrained visual representations.
blocks.zh:
为了检验分阶段的调节是否防止代表崩溃(第3.1节),我们比较了渐进式和完全微调式.
评估VIPE回收的轨迹[17],渐进的微调同时减少旋转和翻译错误(表6).
这证实了逐渐解冻的分支对于学习几何控制,同时保留预先训练的视觉表现至关重要.

blocks.en:
To test whether explicit sound-source binding improves joint generation, we compare three caption formats (Sec. 2 ): video-only (V), video-plus-audio (V + + A), and three-track (V + + A + + AV).
Cross-evaluating across prompt formats, three-track captions consistently yield the highest ImageBind similarity (Table 6 ).
This confirms that richer audio-visual descriptions provide direct correspondence cues, strengthening cross-modal consistency.
blocks.zh:
为了检验明确音源绑定是否改善了联合生成,我们比较了三种标题格式(sec.2):仅视频(V),视频+-音频(V+A),以及三轨(V+A+A+A+AV).
跨快速格式的交叉评价,三轨标题始终产生最高的ImageBind相似性(表6)。
这证实,较丰富的视听描述提供了直接的通信提示,加强了跨模式的一致性。

To test whether online trajectory distillation ( ℒ traj {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{traj}} ) curbs rollout drift while preserving sample diversity (Sec. 3.2 ), we compare self-forcing training with and without ℒ traj {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{traj}} on top of DMD.
As shown in Table 8 , incorporating ℒ traj {\mathcal{L}}_{\mathrm{traj}} improves overall WBench performance, with marked gains in consistency and physical plausibility.
In extended 30-s rollouts, Figure 8 demonstrates that trajectory guidance mitigates visual drift, maintaining cloud structures and scene landmarks with far fewer artifacts.
It also boosts feature diversity on DINOv3 and CLIP over DMD alone (Table 8 ; Appendix E ).
These findings validate that anchoring student rollouts to the teacher’s probability flow stabilizes autoregressive generation without mode collapse.

它还使DINOv3和CLIP的多样性超过DMD(表8;附录E)。
这些发现证实,将学生推向教师的概率流稳定在不发生模式崩溃的情况下的自动递减生成。

blocks.en:
To evaluate whether long-horizon tuning sustains generation quality over extended sequences (Sec. 3.2 ), we apply it to both self-forcing variants.
As shown in Table 8 , long-horizon tuning delivers consistent, orthogonal gains across both setups, improving overall performance over baselines.
When combined with trajectory distillation, it achieves best overall score.
This confirms that truncated streaming supervision effectively complements block-level trajectory guidance, enabling stable and interactive rollouts over extended horizons.

这证实了短流式监督有效补充了区块级轨迹指导,使稳定和互动地在延伸的视野中展开。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
Interactive world models [ 12 ] simulate future observations under diverse controls, including latent codes [ 1 , 31 ] , keyboard actions [ 40 , 7 , 3 , 53 , 23 ] , 6-DoF camera trajectories [ 14 , 24 ] , and hybrid inputs [ 37 ] .
Yet, prevailing models remain silent; while EchoWM [ 52 ] incorporates audio, it lacks camera-conditioned spatial acoustics.
HelixWorld conditions a joint audio-visual backbone on continuous camera trajectories and discrete actions, steering viewpoints alongside responsive spatial acoustics.
blocks.zh:
交互世界模型 [12] 模拟未来在不同控制下进行的观测,包括潜在代码[1,31],键盘动作[40,7,3,53,23],6-DoF相机轨迹[14,24],以及混合输入[37].
然而,流行的模型仍然保持沉默;虽然EchoWM[52]包含了音频,但它缺乏照相机条件的空间声学.
HelixWorld为连续相机轨迹和离散动作提供联合视听骨干条件,与应答空间声学一起引导视线.

blocks.en:
Cascaded systems dub pre-rendered video via video-to-audio synthesis [ 6 , 38 ] , but post-hoc dubbing lacks camera extrinsics or control intents, and compounding latency prevents real-time interaction.
In contrast, joint models [ 13 , 11 ] co-denoise video and audio tokens in a shared transformer for cross-modal synchrony.
Yet, they remain passive and bidirectional, operating on fixed-length clips without control interfaces or streaming inference.
We bring interactive control and causal streaming to joint models.
blocks.zh:
cascaded systems dub通过视频对音频合成预发视频[6,38],但hoc后杜宾缺乏相机外观或控制意图,复合延迟阻碍实时交互.
相比之下,联合型号[13,11]在一台用于跨模式同步的共享变压器中共同代号视频和音频代号.
然而,它们仍然是被动和双向的,在固定长的夹片上运作,没有控制接口或流推论.
我们给联合模式带来互动控制和因果流。

blocks.en:
Deploying diffusion models interactively requires converting bidirectional generation into causal streaming.
Recent video distillation schemes mitigate exposure bias through distribution matching (DMD) [ 49 , 48 ] , on-policy KV rollouts (Self-Forcing) [ 18 ] , ODE regression [ 56 ] , and long-horizon streaming tuning [ 46 ] .
However, these techniques target video alone.
When extended to joint audio-visual diffusion, distribution matching suffers from mode collapse, causing color degradation and acoustic dropouts over extended rollouts.
We stabilize self-forcing with an online trajectory distillation loss, anchoring the student’s joint velocity field against teacher probability flows.
blocks.zh:
以互动方式部署传播模型需要将双向生成转化为因果流.
近期的视频蒸馏计划通过配对(DMD)[49,48],政策性KV推出(自强)[18],ODE回归[56],以及长视流调[46],减轻曝光偏差.
然而,这些技术仅针对视频.
在推广到联合视听传播时,分发匹配会出现模式崩溃,在扩展推出后造成颜色退化和声学辍学。
校对:Soup

blocks.en:
World-model benchmarks such as WBench [ 51 ] assess action-conditioned video dynamics but ignore audio entirely.
Conversely, audio-visual benchmarks [ 4 ] measure semantic correspondence (ImageBind [ 10 ] , CLAP [ 45 ] ) and onset synchrony (Synchformer [ 19 ] , AV-Align [ 47 ] ) on short, fixed-viewpoint clips.
While these metrics evaluate what sounds occur and when , they cannot test where sounds originate relative to a moving listener under viewpoint motion.
HelixBench addresses this gap, formalizing spatial-acoustic consistency alongside temporal, semantic, and dynamic metrics for interactive audio-visual evaluation.
blocks.zh:
WBench [51]等世界模型基准评估了行动有条件的视频动态,但完全忽略了音频.
反之,视听基准 [4] 测量语义通信(ImageBind [10],CLAP [45])和发声同步(Synchformer [19],AV-Align [47])在短片,固定视点剪辑上.
虽然这些衡量标准评价了声音的发生和何时发生,但它们不能测试声音的发源地相对于视距运动下的移动听众.
Helix Bench解决了这一差距,将空间-音响一致性与时间、语义和动态度量法正式化,用于交互式视听评价。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and spatial stereo soundscapes co-evolve natively under dynamic user control.
Coupled with a compute-prioritized data curation pipeline, our causal distillation framework suppresses compounding rollout drift to sustain synchronized 24 24 FPS streaming on a single GPU.
Finally, we formalize spatial-acoustic consistency as a foundational criterion separating interactive world models from passive generation, and introduce HelixBench to systematically evaluate it.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们介绍了HelixWorld,一种实时交互式视听世界模型,视觉场景和空间立体声景在动态用户控制下共同演化.
加上一个计算优先的数据校正管道, 我们的因果蒸馏框架 抑制复合的展开漂移 维持同步2424 FPS流 在单一的GPU上。
最后,我们正式将空间-声学一致性作为将交互式世界模型与被动生成区分开来的基础标准,并引入Helix Bench系统评价.

blocks.en:
Raw footage exhibits pervasive distribution corruption, including dual-mono downmixes, rapid montage cuts, static title cards, and interface clutter.
Stage 1 executes lightweight signal probes to eliminate defective footage prior to compute-intensive neural processing.
blocks.zh:

第1阶段执行轻量级信号探测器,在计算密集神经处理前消除有缺陷的镜头.

blocks.en:
The ingestion probe enforces strict container constraints: video streams must have a spatial resolution of at least 768 × 512 768{\times}512 with horizontal landscape aspect ratio, and frame rates bounded within [ 23.9,121 ] [23.9,121] fps (subsequently normalized to 24 24 fps).
The audio stream must contain a valid two-channel stereo track, immediately pruning mono downmixes and missing audio streams.
Clips failing container integrity or exhibiting corrupt stream headers are pruned immediately.

损坏容器完整性或显示腐败的溪流头部的剪贴片立即被剪贴。

We employ PySceneDetect [ 2 ] to segment continuous shots, tracking HSV color histogram differences across frames subsampled at 4 4 fps.
A cut boundary is placed whenever the histogram difference exceeds 0.35 0.35 .
Fragmented shots shorter than 5 5 seconds are dropped to prevent abrupt scene cuts from contaminating the temporal attention window.
Furthermore, any video whose mean continuous shot duration falls below 2 2 seconds (e.g., promotional trailers or rapid montages) is rejected in its entirety.

Surviving continuous shots are segmented into standardized clips matching the backbone training context: exactly 121 121 video frames at 24 24 fps ( 5.04 5.04 s) at 768 × 512 768{\times}512 resolution, coupled with synchronized two-channel 48 48 kHz stereo audio ( 241,920 241{,}920 audio samples per clip).
Shots are tiled front-to-back without overlap.
To maximize data efficiency, whenever a trailing segment exceeds 2.5 2.5 s, an additional clip is carved backwards from the shot terminus, raising temporal coverage from 98.4 % 98.4\% to 100 % 100\% .
Audio and video streams are sliced synchronously in a single ffmpeg pass, ensuring microsecond-level temporal synchronization by construction.

blocks.en: C.3 Semantic Filtering with Audio-Visual MLLM (Stage 3)
blocks.zh: C.3 用视听MLLM进行语义过滤(第3阶段)

blocks.en:
While low-level heuristic probes eliminate signal defects, they cannot reason about high-level multimodal semantics: pixel differences fail to separate 3D physical environments from 2D screen recordings or talking heads, and audio format checks cannot detect added background music.
Stage 3 deploys an audio-visual foundation model (Qwen3-Omni-30B [ 33 ] ) to evaluate video and audio synchronously under constrained grammar decoding.
A clip is retained if and only if it satisfies two physical criteria: • Visual scene integrity : The clip must depict an authentic 3D physical environment undergoing dynamic physical evolution, strictly excluding non-world content (e.g., talking-head interviews, desktop screencasts, picture-in-picture feeds) and intrusive graphic or subtitle overlays. • Acoustic authenticity : The clip must feature natural diegetic sound, systematically pruning post-production background music, voiceover narration, and artificial sound effects.
Crucially, acoustic filtering evaluates sounds by their physical genesis rather than source visibility: off-screen environmental sounds (e.g., thunder or passing vehicles) are preserved as authentic diegetic acoustics. Because soundtrack contamination typically spans an entire video, we apply an early termination heuristic: if 10 10 consecutive clips within an upload are flagged for non-diegetic audio, the remainder of that upload is terminated immediately, saving substantial inference compute.
blocks.zh:
虽然低水平的heuristic探测器消除了信号缺陷,但无法为高水平的多模式语义解说理由:像素差异未能将3D物理环境与2D屏幕录音或谈话头分离,音频格式检查无法检测到添加的背景音乐.
第三阶段部署视听基础模型(Qune3-Omni-30B[33]),在受限的语法解码下对视频和音频同步进行评价.
如果且只有在符合两个物理标准时才保留一个剪辑: 片段必须描绘正经历动态物理演化的正宗的3D物理环境,严格排除非世界内容(如对话头访谈,桌面屏幕播放器,图片摄像头)和侵入性图形或字幕覆盖. • 声学真实性: 剪辑必须突出自然的diegetic声音,系统地播放制作后的背景音乐,语音翻唱,以及人工音效.
关键的是,声波滤波通过声音的物理起源而不是源的能见度来评价声音: 外屏环境声(如雷声或过路车辆)被保留为真实的定音声. 因为音轨污染通常会横跨整个视频,所以我们应用了早期终止热度:如果一个上传中连续的10个片段被标记为非刻录音频,那么其余的上传部分会立即终止,从而节省大量的推论计算.

blocks.zh: C.4 摄影机Pose估计和计量尺度恢复(第4阶段)

blocks.en:
High-fidelity interactive world modeling requires precise, metric-scaled 6-DoF camera trajectories.
For game footage, camera extrinsics and focal parameters are logged directly from engine telemetry.
For real-world and open-source footage, we develop a multi-view geometric estimation and metric scale recovery pipeline.

blocks.en: C.5 Decoupled Multimodal Captioning (Stage 4)
blocks.zh: C.5 脱钩的多式联运说明(步骤4)

blocks.en:
Conditioning an interactive audio-visual world model on a single entangled text prompt induces cross-modal hallucination during training (e.g., visual models hallucinating sound effects that are absent, or audio models generating voices when text mentions visible actors).
To prevent cross-modal contamination, we formulate a decoupled caption contract comprising three independent caption streams per clip, generated using Qwen3-Omni-30B [ 33 ] via isolated forward passes: • Visual caption ( V V ) : Describes setting and salient subject motion while strictly ignoring audio. Viewpoint changes and camera-induced parallax are forbidden in the text, ensuring camera dynamics remain exclusively governed by camera conditioning. • Audio caption ( A A ) : Describes acoustic layers, event order, and temporal dynamics while ignoring visual content. Because captioning uses a mono downmix, directional terms (e.g., left/right) are strictly prohibited, preserving stereo panning for geometric control. Speech is treated as ambient sound without transcription. • Joint audio-visual caption ( A ​ V AV ) : Explicitly grounds audible events to visible on-screen emitters, tracking cross-modal synchronization and volume changes as sound sources enter or leave the camera frustum. This tripartite representation eliminates textual cross-talk and provides the structured textual supervision for the caption ablation in Sec. 5.2 .
blocks.zh:
在单条缠绕文本的提示上设定交互式视听世界模型,在训练中诱发跨模式的幻觉(例如视觉模型对缺失的声音效果产生幻觉,或者在文本提及可见演员时产生声音的音频模型).
为了防止跨模式污染,我们拟订了一份脱钩字幕合同,每段由三个独立字幕流组成,使用Qune3-Omni-30B[33]通过孤立的前方通行证生成: 描述设置和突出的主题运动,同时严格忽略音频. 文本中禁止视点变化和相机引发的抛物,确保相机动力学仍然完全受相机调制的制约. • 音频字幕(AA): 描述声层,事件顺序,以及时间动态,同时忽略视觉内容. 由于字幕使用单调下混音,因此严格禁止方向词(如左/右),为几何控制保留立体声压. 发言作为没有抄录的环境声音处理。 • 联合视听字幕(A V AV): 随着声音源进入或离开摄像头,明确为屏幕发射器可见的可见事件提供理由,跟踪跨模式同步和音量变化. 这种三方表述消除了文字上的交叉交谈,为第5.2节中的标题表达提供了结构化的文字监督。

blocks.en: D.1 Case Selection

blocks.en:
Each case carries a scene label and an interaction label, assigned by human annotators as content descriptions.
Per-metric applicability is decided separately from the content labels, so label counts are not metric denominators; each metric reports on its applicable subset together with the number of scored and non-scorable cases.
The benchmark contains 1,015 1{,}015 cases; DeSync applies to the 165 165 Event cases, and the spatial score to the Perspective subset.
blocks.zh:
每个案件都带有场景标签和互动标签,被人类注释者指定为内容描述.
量度适用性与内容标签分开决定,所以标签计数不是度量分母;每个度量报告有关其可适用的子集,加上得分和不可分数的案例数.
基准包含1,015 1{,}015个案例;DeSync适用于165个事件案例,空间分数适用于Perspect子集.

blocks.en:
Sources are isolated from the training corpus at the whole-video level; a source that matches training data cannot re-enter through a different time window.
Candidate windows pass technical gates: frame continuity over the full clip (scene cuts, black or frozen frames, montage effects), audio continuity and audibility (missing audio, long or edge silences, suspected fades via RMS-envelope checks), and a true-stereo gate (side/mid energy ratio ≤ − 45 \leq-45 dB rejected; weak-stereo cases routed to review), since duplicated mono channels carry no spatial information.
blocks.zh:
来源与整个视频一级的培训机构隔离;匹配培训数据的来源不能通过不同的时间窗口重新进入。
候选窗口通过技术门:全片片段的帧连续性(剪刀、黑框或冷框、蒙太奇效应)、音频连续性和可见性(缺少音频、长片或边缘沉默、疑似通过RMS-envelp检查而淡出),以及真实的定形门(侧/中能量比 − − 45\leq-45 dB被拒绝;经路由审查的弱定形案),因为重复的单声道没有空间信息。

blocks.en:
The spatial subset is built by scanning full source videos: stereo energy and direction statistics are computed in 0.1-second windows, candidate anchors are proposed from audio events and visual changes under a per-interval budget, and windows of about 5 seconds are cut around anchors.
A case is admitted only if a single dominant sound source is visible and localizable; the source is bound with open-vocabulary detection using visual evidence alone, so audio direction never influences which object is selected.
Background music, rain, waves, and multi-source scenes are excluded; a reference alignment threshold selects candidates for human review, and overlapping windows are removed.
